item.title: Perception is all that matters
item.description:
There is something we don’t talk about enough in our lives.

Where should I start? I’m kind of new to this… Should I describe my experience to you? Should I talk about the perception of things?

Lately, I’ve been finding more and more that perception is all that matters.

Do you want that promotion? Have you been working hard? Did you say something funny? Did everyone laugh? Have you told the same joke to another group of people, and it landed completely differently?

item.title: About
item.description:
I’m a backend software engineer at Datadog in Paris, working on the error deobfuscation platform: the systems that turn minified JavaScript and native crash reports into readable stack traces.

I have 7+ years of experience building reliable, cost-efficient distributed systems. At Datadog, I shipped JavaScript Debug IDs, cutting duplicated symbol ingestion by 95%+, delivered native crash symbolication across Windows, macOS, iOS and Linux, and cut on-call pages by 98%.

Skills

  • Key skills: Backend Systems, Distributed Systems, Production Incident Investigation, Observability, Systems Reliability
  • Programming: Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL (PostgreSQL)
  • Tools: Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Kafka, Redis, AWS S3, gRPC, Datadog, Bazel
  • Languages: Portuguese (native), English (C1-C2), French (B1)

Milestones

  • Sep 2026: Shipped JavaScript Debug ID support for source maps at Datadog (docs).
  • Apr 2026: Started as a Software Engineer at Datadog, on the error deobfuscation platform.
  • 2024: Altice Labs Award for Best Master’s Student, Évora University (certificate).
  • 2024: Datadog Top Dog Award (Q2).

Education

  • Master of Software Engineering, Évora University (2024). Thesis: Medical Data Hub, a privacy-first platform for querying and processing sensitive medical data.
  • Bachelor of Software Engineering, Coimbra Higher Institute of Engineering (2019). Internship thesis.

Outside work

I enjoy reading non-fiction and leadership books, investing, startup operations, football and my homelab.
